_comment: The tools /install/ lists, and the only file to edit when that changes. Studio opens the page; every other
entry is a card below it, and every entry with a `package` joins the install-everything block.
A `repo` is a BotMakerDev repository. The build asks GitHub for its latest release and writes that
version into the page; a version is never typed here, because a typed version is wrong the day after the
`package` names the dnf/apt package a repository publishes, and is also the basename of the `.repo` file
its own Pages site serves (`<pages>/<repo>/<package>.repo` — the shape every build-repo.sh writes). Omit it
for something that is not installed from a repository; then `asset` names the release asset to download
instead. `site: false` for a repository that publishes no Pages site.
`blurb` and `also` are plain text: `backticks` mark code, and nothing else is markup.

tools.name: BotMaker Studio
tools.blurb: The IDE: snap blocks together and get real Java, run it, publish it.

tools.name: botmaker (CLI)
tools.blurb: The command: new plugins and bots, validate, run, publish, release, doctor. One jar, every system.

tools.name: BotMaker Dashboard
tools.blurb: The maintainer's window: module pins, release history, the Release tab, the catalog.

tools.name: Remote Server
tools.blurb: Serves the tmux session `claude` as terminals over WebSocket, on the Tailscale address only.

tools.name: BotPilot (Android)
tools.blurb: The phone app for the SDK's Remote Pilot: pair by QR, watch the run, take over.

tools.name: BotMaker Remote (Android)
tools.blurb: The phone client for Remote Server: session list, terminal, quick replies, notifications.
